title: Chapter 482
text:
All the passersby within the protective barrier were sent out to watch the battle from the outside. It was not a big deal to watch a good show. Ovenn and Ashes, one chasing the other, had already left the area and were not locked up by the protective shield.

More security teams were waiting outside the shield, and there were at least a thousand spacecrafts. The guardians hired by the financial groups had already entered the shield and stood at the edge of the battlefield, monitoring the situation. They had no intention of interfering for the time being.

Seeing this scene, the faces of Dark-star and the mercenaries changed slightly. They felt as if they were locked in a cage.

"The area is locked down? Looks like the situation is too bad. "

Anur's heart sank. After causing such a big commotion, Noriose could not stay for long. After Ovenn died, they would have to evacuate. Dark-star's fleet was already on standby in outer space, ready to receive them at any time. They would probably clash with Noriose's space defense fleet … but there was nothing to be afraid of.

Anur still remembered Ashes' embarrassing battle a few days ago. "If I stay here to delay the enemy, it might be beneficial for the overall situation. Ashes has already failed once, and he might not be able to deal with the siege of Nagojin and Black Star. He can't take on such a heavy responsibility. After the battle is over, it will be easier for me to evacuate than him. My speed will make me invincible."

On the other side, the appearance of the protective shield made Han Xiaoxin's head shake. He had a bad feeling.

The area lockdown seemed to limit Anur's range of activity, but it was actually an extremely disadvantageous factor. It meant that Anur did not have any scruples.

In the sealed area, Anur could use his ability without any scruples, turning the air in the area into a vortex that could destroy everything!

Moreover, the protective shield separated the passersby. Han Xiao originally wanted to use Anur's destructive power. Dragging some passers-by into this matter was no longer feasible.

Boom!

Han Xiao was hit in the chest by the wind pressure cannon. The armor caved in, and he was sent flying again. His face was ugly.

"The situation is really bad. I wonder how my officers are doing."

…

Far away from the center of the battlefield, Fu Ding and Sylvia were retreating into the distance. They were originally hiding nearby, but as the battlefield expanded, they had no choice but to move away to avoid being targeted by the enemy.

"Let, let go of me, I want to go back and help!"

Sylvia's tone was anxious, and her face was red from exerting too much force. She wanted to shake off Fu Ding's hand.

Fu Ding held Sylvia's wrist tightly and pulled her forward. He sighed and said, "Stop fooling around. You can't help. Any enemy can easily kill you. Didn't you see the battle in the sky? As long as you get sucked into that hurricane, you're dead meat."

"I …" Sylvia was speechless. She said angrily, "But you can help!"

"I don't want to get involved in your mercenary group's mission. This has nothing to do with me."

Fu Ding shook his head.

Sylvia was furious. She bit Fu Ding's hand and wanted him to let go.

Fu Ding felt a slight pain. He lowered his head and looked at the back of his hand that was bleeding. He sighed helplessly and said, "No matter what you say, I can't watch you die without doing anything."

At this moment, footsteps sounded in front of them. A Dark-star member blocked their path.

"Heh, two lost fishes that slipped through the net."

Sinesa sneered. She had just killed a Grade B mercenary nearby and had sensed the commotion. Thus, she had blocked their path.

Fu Ding and Sylvia's expressions changed.

Sylvia hurriedly pulled out her alloy sword. Her hands were trembling slightly. She wanted to control her hand, but Sinesa's Grade B pressure made her, who was only a Grade D Super, instinctively feel fear. Her body was unable to calm down.

At this moment, Fu Ding pushed Sylvia behind him.

"Quickly run. I'll stop her."

Fu Ding's tone was calm.

Hu!

An invisible force rushed toward the two of them, interrupting Sylvia's words before she could say anything.

Fu Ding opened his mouth, and singing came out of his mouth. He formed an invisible barrier with his psychic energy to protect the two of them. However, the next moment, it shattered, and the two of them were sent flying.

"Only a Grade C?"

Sinesa was a little disappointed. She thought that she had caught a big fish, but it turned out that they were just two small shrimps.

Sylvia's butt hurt from the fall, but she realized that she was not injured at all. That attack was just a probe. Although Fu Ding's psychic energy shield had shattered, it had still blocked a lot of the power. Furthermore, most of the damage had been taken by Fu Ding.

Standing up, Fu Ding felt that his nose was warm. He wiped it, and his hand was covered in blood. He felt as though his brain was being pricked by needles.

He endured the pain and tried his best to maintain a calm expression. He turned to look at Sylvia, forced a smile, and said, "I'm fine. Don't stay here. Otherwise, I'll have to take care of you."

Sylvia heard this and gritted her teeth. She grabbed her alloy sword and turned around to escape. She was very decisive.

She knew that she was not strong enough, and she would only cause more trouble if she stayed.

Fu Ding turned around to face the enemy. He adjusted his clothes, took a deep breath, and silently activated his psychic energy.

"You're not going to escape?" Sinesa was interested.

"We're both psychics. There's no harm in having a little spar." Fu Ding forced a smile.

Sinesa opened her eyes wide and said in astonishment, "You, a Grade C psychic, want to have a spar with me?"

"Frankly speaking, this is the first time I'm using psychic energy to fight. I don't like fighting. If you can let me go, I'll be very grateful."

Fu Ding's tone was serious.

Sinesa did not know whether to laugh or cry. She was too lazy to talk nonsense. She directly released her psychic energy, preparing to get rid of this guy blocking her path before chasing after the little girl who was running away.

Anyway, it would not take much time.

Bang, bang, bang!

The air between the two of them distorted, and a series of shockwaves burst out. The formless psychic energy crazily clashed.

Pu!

In just a few seconds, Fu Ding seemed to have suffered a heavy blow. His head was raised high, and blood spurted out from his seven orifices. He rolled and fell to the ground, not moving anymore.

"You overestimate yourself."

Sinesa clicked her tongue and walked past Fu Ding's body.

Just as she was about to chase after Sylvia, Fu Ding's weak voice sounded from behind her.

"Cough cough … Fighting is really difficult. I'm really not used to such crude behavior …"

Fu Ding stood up shakily. His face was covered in blood. Blood flowed down his elegant chin and dripped down.

Sinesa turned around and frowned. She was rather surprised. Her psychic energy had completely suppressed him. Logically speaking, she should have turned his brain into a pile of mush.

… Forget it. It would be the same even if she made up for it.

Feidin coughed out a mouthful of blood and said softly with a bitter smile, "I shouldn't have tried to be brave. I'm not cut out for this … Yes, yes, yes, I'm trash, okay? Stop scolding me, my head hurts enough … Uh, I know you're in pain too. Be good, stop arguing. I promise you, okay? Just don't let my body die, it's yours … Sigh, I'm really unwilling."

"Who are you talking to?"

Sinesa was confused. She turned around and saw that there was no one else beside her. She immediately understood. This person had been beaten to the point that his mind was in a mess.

"You're unlucky to have met me." Sinesa released her psychic energy once again. She did not need to hesitate when killing her enemies.

Boom!

The next moment, Sinesa felt a loud sound in her ears that echoed like a bell. Her brain felt as though it had been struck by a hammer, and Feidin did not move at all. Instead, she was the one who was sent flying.

With a bang, Sinesa fell to the ground and spat out a mouthful of blood. She was stunned for a moment before regaining her senses. She looked at Fu Ding in shock.

What was going on?

Fu Ding seemed to have changed into another person. His temperament was completely different. His movements were gentle, and he slowly wiped away the blood on his face. He was like a woman, but his gaze was hysterical, with a hint of joy from finally escaping.

"Why do I feel that I'm lucky to have met you? I was just worried that I wouldn't be able to find a target to vent my anger on!"

Fu Ding … No, Chen Xing's body was surrounded by psychic energy that was dozens of times stronger than before. Sand and pebbles flew in all directions.

Seeing this, Sinesa's expression changed drastically.

"You like fighting, right? I'll play with you!"
